initial_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Offices and similar' AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 90 ORDER BY id ASC

scenario_definition.name: 3 omitted dimensions; intended use: University Student Residence (specific CDP/PNRR grant); vague first answer on L

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an office building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program.
L: It depends; something suitable for the project, I guess.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: A student residence needs convenient access to education services; threshold is at least the 75th percentile (89.89).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Offices and similar' AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 90 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters for the specified office property type, energy classes A1 through C, and education score of at least 90; orders by ID because no location was provided.
